tasks.title: Announcement #72
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement on the school radio.
tasks.transcript: Attention all students. The main campus bookstore is back and better than ever after a major renovation. And to celebrate, we're holding a special one day sale tomorrow from 8 a.m. To 6 p.m. All textbooks, supplies and school merchandise will be discounted by 20%. A perfect chance to stock up for the new semester. And when you're done shopping, don't forget to slow down and check out our newly added basement cafe and enjoy a complimentary cup of coffee.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?

options.A: A change in campus bookstore hours
options.B: The opening of a new bookstore
options.C: Promotional events at the campus bookstore
options.D: The arrival of this semester's textbooks

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：The main campus bookstore is back and better than ever after a major renovation. And to celebrate, we‘re holding a special one day sale tomorrow... 选项分析： A. A change in campus bookstore hours 校园书店营业时间的变更。公告中未提及营业时间变化，所以A选项错误。 B. The opening of a new bookstore 一家新书店的开业。公告中说的是原有书店翻新后重新营业，并非新书店，所以B选项错误。 C. Promotional events at the campus bookstore 校园书店的促销活动。公告主要内容是书店翻新后重新开业，并举办为期一天的打折促销，所以C选项正确。 D. The arrival of this semester’s textbooks 本学期教材的到货。公告中未提及教材到货，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What are students encouraged to do?

options.A: Return their textbooks from the last semester
options.B: Take a relaxing break at the café downstairs
options.C: Look online for available discount codes
options.D: Browse the selection of interesting new books

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：鼓励学生们做什么？ 定位原文：And when you're done shopping, don't forget to slow down and check out our newly added basement cafe and enjoy a complimentary cup of coffee. 选项分析： A. Return their textbooks from the last semester 归还上学期的教材。公告中未提及归还教材，所以A选项错误。 B. Take a relaxing break at the café downstairs 在楼下的咖啡馆放松休息。公告明确说购物结束后，去新增加的地下咖啡馆看看，并享用一杯免费咖啡，所以B选项正确。 C. Look online for available discount codes 在网上查找可用的折扣码。公告中未提及折扣码，所以C选项错误。 D. Browse the selection of interesting new books 浏览有趣的新书。公告中提到有商品折扣，但未特别强调浏览新书，所以D选项不够准确。
